scripts.upgrade:all: npm run upgrade:akshare && npm run upgrade:aktools
scripts.start:server:aktools: p=$(lsof -ti:6670); [ -n "$p" ] && kill -9 $p; cd Back-End/ak/aktools && python3.11 -m aktools --port 6670
scripts.start:frontend:aktools: p=$(lsof -ti:6671); [ -n "$p" ] && kill -9 $p; cd Front-End && yarn vite --port 6671 --mode aktools
scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; npm run start:server:aktools & npm run start:frontend:aktools
scripts.start:server:akshare: p=$(lsof -ti:6680); [ -n "$p" ] && kill -9 $p; cd Back-End/ak/akshare && python3.11 app.py --port 6680
